page.notes: Marginal note beside "Hic D. G." reads "in Rom. 5. 15." (reference). Greek word in the first paragraph is illegible in detail; transcribed as printed as best possible. The Greek words "ἀρχαῖος" and "χάρισμα" are uncertain: "ἀρχαῖος" marked as doubtful, possibly "παράπτωμα". Text "Caluini" and "Placeus" as printed.
